lines.zh: 蹦过红蘑菇，又蹦过棕蘑菇。
lines.en: A hop past a red mushroom, then a brown one.

lines.zh: 头顶菌盖一晃一晃地走。
lines.en: Cap bobbing as I trot along.

lines.zh: 在菌丝地面留下小脚印。
lines.en: Small prints on the mycelium ground.
Around a cluster of caps, hopping on.

lines.zh: 顺着蘑菇岛的缓坡向上。
lines.en: Up the gentle slope of the mushroom island.

lines.zh: 边走边嗅空气里的孢子味。
lines.en: Sniffing spores in the air as I go.

lines.zh: 蘑菇岛上的阳光，晒得菌盖暖暖。
lines.en: Mushroom Island sun warms my cap.
Sitting under a cap to dodge the drizzle.

lines.zh: 把一颗棕蘑菇抱在怀里。
lines.en: Hugging one brown mushroom to my chest.
My cap leans toward the sun.

lines.zh: 用小手拍了拍身边的土。
lines.en: Patting the soil beside me with a small hand.

lines.zh: 数着脚下新长出的菌丝。
lines.en: Counting new mycelium at my feet.

lines.zh: 打个饱嗝，孢子都飘出来。
lines.en: A full burp, and spores drift out.
My gills open and close as I watch you.

lines.zh: 从菌盖后探出头来看你。
lines.en: I peek out from behind my cap at you.

lines.zh: 你手里的蘑菇，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the mushroom in your hand.
Spores are leaking out. So dizzy!
Eating mushrooms is natural to us!

lines.zh: 闻到蘑菇味了，给我一个。
lines.en: I smell mushrooms, give me one.

lines.zh: 这株蘑菇，我能种在你门口。
lines.en: I could plant this one by your door.

lines.zh: 菌盖上的斑点越多越甜。
lines.en: The more spots on a cap, the sweeter it is.

lines.zh: 小麦给我，我给你种一片。
lines.en: Wheat for me, and I plant you a patch.
Not that one; it is not ripe yet.

lines.zh: 蘑菇岛的土，最适合下种。
lines.en: Mushroom island soil is best for planting.

lines.zh: 闻闻我头上的孢子，甜不甜？
lines.en: Smell the spores on my head. Sweet?
Don't run, you might get bumped!
Be careful, don't bump the mushroom island!
Be safe, don't bump into me.
Watch out, I'm easy to bump.
On Mushroom Island, let us plant a patch together.

lines.zh: 蘑菇岛的菌丝，替我牵线。
lines.en: Mushroom Island mycelium draws us together.
Reproduce together, grow the mushroom island.
Find a partner, share the mushrooms.

lines.zh: 我这顶蘑菇，是自己种的。
lines.en: This mushroom cap on me is one I planted.
Leaving little mushrooms on Mushroom Island.
Find a partner, plant the future.

lines.zh: 繁殖后代，让蘑菇岛更强大。
lines.en: Reproduce, make the mushroom island stronger.
Let our two caps press together.
Wow! This is my new home!
I’m going home to grow mushrooms!
This is my seed! Take it!

lines.zh: 小麦可以让我快点繁殖！
我找到了可以种蘑菇的地方！
lines.en: I found a spot to grow mushrooms!

lines.zh: 谢谢你的蘑菇，我会种好它们！
lines.en: Thanks for the mushrooms, I’ll grow them!
My red cap turns toward you, I've caught up.
Don't step on my mushroom ring, get back.
I’m the guardian of the mushroom island!
I don’t eat my own kind!

lines.zh: 蘑菇岛上这排红伞，是我种的。
lines.en: The red caps on this island, I planted them.

lines.zh: 发出轻微的嘶嘶声，咬下一口蘑菇
lines.en: Makes a soft hiss, chomping on a mushroom

lines.zh: 用尖牙咬破敌人的防护
lines.en: Uses its sharp teeth to break through an enemy's defense

lines.zh: 蘑菇头轻轻摇晃，显示攻击前的警告
lines.en: Shroomie shakes its head slightly, a pre-attack warning

lines.zh: 用触手缠住敌人，然后咬下一片蘑菇
lines.en: Wraps its tentacles around an enemy, then bites off a piece of mushroom

lines.zh: 从敌人身上咬下一块肉，然后咀嚼
lines.en: Bites a chunk of meat from an enemy, then chews

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，警告入侵者
lines.en: Makes a hiss, warning the intruder

lines.zh: 用触手缠住目标，然后咬下蘑菇
lines.en: Wraps its tentacles around the target, then bites a mushroom

lines.zh: 用小爪子抓住敌人，然后咬下蘑菇
lines.en: Grasps the enemy with its small claws, then bites a mushroom

lines.zh: 嘶嘶地警告敌人，然后咬下一片蘑菇
lines.en: Hisses at the enemy, then bites a piece of mushroom
A shove of my cap knocks you aside!

lines.zh: 在蘑菇上孵化出小蘑菇头
lines.en: Hatches small Shroomies on a mushroom
Spawns randomly from a spore ball
A Shroomie hatches from a mushroom

lines.zh: 孢子球破裂，蘑菇头出现
lines.en: A spore ball bursts, revealing a Shroomie

lines.zh: 蘑菇中的孢子孵化出蘑菇头
lines.en: A Shroomie hatches from spores in a mushroom
Spawns randomly from a spore ball

lines.zh: 孢子球中孵化出新的蘑菇头
lines.en: New Shroomies hatch from a spore ball
